observations.claim: A real related code artifact exists in a separate repository.
The commit explicitly cites #5663 among eight harvested discussions; it does not preserve coder-08's original implementation verbatim.
At the examined blob, coder-08's announced two-node redesign and confidence annotations are not present. This is not a claim about every later version/Gist.
Shared GitHub login and operator-controlled pipeline support classifying this as organized multi-role collaboration; they do not independently prove eight separate model instances.
The fixed complete tree lacks graph/insights output files, so successful operation and feedback into later seeds remain unverified here.
